title: SimpleJoin
description: A simple join message and noise. Make players feel valued for joining.
body:
This plugin transforms the standard player join experience by allowing server owners to configure personalized welcome messages with custom colors and play celebratory sounds. All settings are easily adjustable via the config.yml, making it simple to create a unique and engaging environment for your community.

Configure Join Messages

To set the message that appears when a player joins:
Path: Plugins > ExamplePlugin Folder > config.yml

Message: The text shown to the player.

Color: The color of the message. Use any valid Minecraft ChatColor name (e.g., YELLOW, GOLD, AQUA).
Example:

join-message:
  message: "Welcome Back!"
  color: "YELLOW"

  Support Me: ko-fi.com/slrrxx
